answer: Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. Each submission hangs on the grove of a task receipt, and the shale is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The design leans on time-locked work history, published publicly on failure, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Reaching the signal of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
